description: A power-nap countdown with 10/20/26/90-minute presets, custom length and a gentle wake-up chime.

faqs.a: A 10–20 minute power nap boosts alertness without grogginess; 90 minutes completes a full sleep cycle. The 26-minute preset comes from NASA's famous cockpit-nap study.
faqs.q: Which nap length should I choose?

faqs.a: Yes — set any custom length from 1 to 480 minutes.
faqs.q: Can I set a custom nap length?

faqs.a: A soft three-note chime plays when time is up. Keep this tab open and your volume on so you hear it.
faqs.q: How will I be woken up?

howto: Pick a preset or enter a custom number of minutes.
Press Start nap and rest — the countdown runs live.
A gentle chime plays when your nap ends.
title: Nap Timer
